text:
Both responses are accurate. Each gets the 30 June 2027 deadline, the make-good items, the kitchenette condition, the landlord's payment option with its three-month notice, the daily rent risk, and the $18,000 bond terms right. Response A is also clearer for a busy reader: bullets for the work list and bold labels for the exception, alternative and risks. It is close to the 120-word limit, at roughly 120–125 words, but it is slightly over at most. Response B is roughly 165 words, clearly breaking the limit. Its prose is also denser, and it omits nothing the manager needs, so the extra length adds no value. Response A is the better summary.

Verdict: A
